mapper.select: SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_ID , p.image_path, p.PRODUCT_NAME , p.BRAND , p.PRICE , ci.QUANTITY , p.STOCK, (ci.QUANTITY * p.price) AS itemTotalPrice FROM CART_ITEM ci JOIN product p ON ci.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE ci.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY ci.CART_ITEM_ID desc
SELECT CART_ITEM_ID AS cartItemId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, QUANTITY AS quantity FROM CART_ITEM WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item( cart_item_id, member_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( seq_cart_item.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CART_ITEM SET QUANTITY = QUANTITY + #{quantity}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CART_ITEM_id = #{cartItemId} AND MEMBER_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
